summary: Blue Gold Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 28, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq notification on July 24, 2026, that its Market Value of Publicly Held Shares (MVPHS) fell below the $15 million minimum for continued listing on the Nasdaq Global Market. The registrant is the issuer. No specific transaction terms are provided. The company has a 180-day compliance period until January 20, 2027, to regain compliance by closing at $15 million or more for 10 consecutive business days, or it may seek transfer to the Nasdaq Capital Market. This is a routine listing deficiency notification, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisors, risk-arb angle, or deal mechanics are applicable.
